news.headline: Central Florida Thu Nov 26 afternoon: NWS Melbourne River Flood Warning remains in effect, with a Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM and a Small Craft Advisory through Thu 7 PM — Melbourne at 4 PM partly cloudy 70°F, wind W 18 mph gusting 30 mph, rain chance about 1%, Thu low 54°F, Fri high 70°F / low 55°F

Florida construction Nov 26 — Group P6 plans Spoke Aventura, a 21-story, 363-unit rental tower at 2600 N.E. 203rd Street in Miami under the Live Local Act, with 146 units (about 40%) as workforce housing, 3,000 SF of retail and 435 parking spots; RXR supplied a $140 million construction loan, Moss & Associates is general contractor, completion planned for 2028

Florida housing Nov 26 — JLL arranged the sale of and financing for The Juliette, a 330-unit property in Wildwood adjacent to The Villages that opened in 2024; Centennial Holding Co. bought it from Chance Partners for $47.2 million, with units as one- and two-bedroom apartments plus 42 two- and three-bedroom townhomes

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper rebounds Thu Nov 26 from an 11-month low — U.S. copper futures rose 0.74% to $5.3760/lb; ScrapMonster (market data Nov 25): North American clean copper grades slipped another 1 cent/lb after a 25 cent/lb drop Nov 24, E.C. Aluminum Wire gained 1 cent/lb, and LME copper stood at $11,758 per metric tonne, down 2.46% on the day

HVAC — ACHR News: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in an Ekotrope/HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016

Markets closed Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving — U.S. stock and bond markets reopen Fri with an early 1 PM ET stock close; Wednesday's close was mixed: S&P 500 fell 0.25% to 7,182, Dow gained 0.33% to 50,182 and Nasdaq fell 0.62% to 23,585; October core PCE inflation was 3.3% and CME futures priced a 98.1% probability of a 25-basis-point Fed hike on Dec 9

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86, handing Orlando its first NBA Cup loss, and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 in NBA Cup play (Heat now 10-7); next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — Detroit Lions beat the Chicago Bears 29-24 in the early game, with Eagles at Cowboys at 4:30 PM ET and Chiefs at Bills at 8:20 PM ET still to come; no Florida team plays on Thanksgiving — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
